journey.name: Auth: Authentication failure
journey.description: Test that submitting a wrong password for a known username shows an authentication error, and that closing it returns to the form

actions.action: Wait for the authentication form to open.
Type "user" into the username field and "wrongpass" into the password field. Submit the form with the Login button.
Verify that an error screen appears showing the message "Invalid username or password".
Verify that the screen shows a Close button, not a Retry button.
Verify that the authentication form opens.
